dct_title_s: Venezuela - M 7.5 Earthquake - June 2026 - OSM & Overture Data
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains OpenStreetMap data exported from the HOTOSM disaster mapping response to the magnitude 7.5 Earthquake that struck Venezuela in June 2026, Glide: EQ-2026-000093-VEN. On Wednesday, June 24, 2026, Venezuela was struck by two of the most powerful earthquakes the country has seen in over a century. The back-to-back tremors caused widespread destruction, particularly in the capital and along the northern coast. Both earthquakes caused widespread damage across the country, particularly in La Guaira and the capital, Caracas. This dataset bundles nine layers from two sources: * OpenStreetMap layers: buildings, roads, points of interest, health facilities, education facilities, airports, sea ports. * Overture Maps layers: buildings (machine-derived footprints that fill gaps where OSM is sparse) and emergency facilities (hospitals, pharmacies, fire, police, ambulance/EMS). It covers the area affected by the M7.5 earthquake in Venezuela, including the epicentral region and the urban areas of Caracas and La Guaira (bounding box: 69.76°W–65.78°W, 8.70°N–11.51°N). OSM layers have been updated by volunteers through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's Tasking Manager. It is updated as mapping progresses. Full extent (AOI) of the updated OSM buildings data can be found in the file TM Project Extent. Subscribe to this dataset to be notified of any new updates. Tasking Manager Projects for this event are accessible [here](https://tasks.hotosm.org/explore?campaign=2026+Venezuela+Earthquake&omitMapResults=1&status=PUBLISHED%2CARCHIVED%2CDRAFT&orderBy=id&orderByType=DESC). Building density and building predictions are produced by fAIr (https://fair.hotosm.org). fAIr building density and predictions cover the Caracas and La Guaira urban areas only. More details about the activation can be found [here](https://portal.hotosm.org/en/plan/1b604573-8b3d-4506-b372-ccd55fa1c700) Damage assessment validation data in this area can be found [here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/venezuela-m-7-5-earthquake-building-damage-assessment)
